````markdown
# birdseye

A Go CLI for diffing two versions of a Terraform module hosted in
[Crow](../../services/crow/README.md), Immuta's private module registry.

## Build

```bash
make build
./bin/birdseye --help
```

## Usage

One-shot diff (multi-pane TUI on a TTY, unified diff to stdout otherwise):

```
birdseye diff <namespace>/<name>/<provider> <versionA> <versionB>
```

Interactive flow (TUI walks you through module → versions → diff):

```
birdseye diff
```

Common flags:

- `--semantic` — include HCL-aware resource/variable/output diff
- `--plain` / `--no-tui` — force plain unified output even on a TTY
- `--json` — emit structured JSON for scripts
- `--crow-url` — override Crow base URL (env `CROW_URL`)
- `--timeout` — per-HTTP-call timeout (default `30s`)
- `--cache-dir` — override the local tarball cache (default `~/.cache/birdseye`)

List versions for a module:

```
birdseye versions <namespace>/<name>/<provider>
```

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success (including "no differences") |
| 1 | usage error |
| 2 | module version not found in registry |
| 3 | network or registry communication failure |
| 4 | archive corrupt or unsafe |
| 5 | HCL parse error (`--semantic` only) |
| 130 | user cancelled |

## Development

```
make test       # go test ./...
make test-race  # go test -race ./...
make lint       # go vet ./...
```
````
